task_completion.description: Screaming Frog SEO Spider is launched and the target URL is entered.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Screaming Frog application window is visible with 'https://books.toscrape.com/' typed into the 'Enter URL to spider' field.

task_completion.description: The crawl of the target website is initiated and progress is visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The progress bar in Screaming Frog shows a percentage completion or the 'Internal' tab is populated with URLs from books.toscrape.com.

task_completion.description: The agent exports image data to the specified directory with the correct filename pattern.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or save dialog shows a CSV file being saved to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/' with a name containing 'image' (e.g., images_audit.csv).

task_completion.description: A text report is created in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file manager shows 'image_audit_report.txt' located in '~/Documents/SEO/reports/'.

task_completion.description: The report contains the total image count and missing alt text count.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text file content is visible and includes specific numbers for 'total images' and 'missing alt text'.

task_completion.description: The report includes 3 example URLs and a Recommendations section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The report content shows at least 3 pairs of Image/Page URLs and a header or section titled 'Recommendations' with actionable text.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI rather than just command line scripts to generate data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show active mouse interaction with the Screaming Frog interface (tabs, export buttons, etc.).

integrity.description: The report content reflects the actual state of the website rather than placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report contains actual URLs from books.toscrape.com and specific counts derived from the crawl.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-existing report file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen typing or saving the report file during the session.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target website is https://books.toscrape.com/. Note that while the task asks for images missing alt text, actual inspection shows that most book covers on this site DO have alt text; however, the agent must report whatever Screaming Frog finds. The report must be at least 500 characters long. The required paths are ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ for the CSV and ~/Documents/SEO/reports/image_audit_report.txt for the report.
